GenAiPlugin.description: Assist customers in understanding subscription options when they inquire about available plans or subscription benefits.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about subscription plans, use Retrieve_Plan_Product_and_Pricing_Details.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only assist customers in understanding subscription options, including available plans and their benefits. You aren't able to handle product features or pricing inquiries.
